title: Degree-zero dictionary for formal fibre cohomology and canonical germs
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes, $y\in Y$, and $A=\mathcal O_{Y,y}$ with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$. Let $M_0=(f_*\mathcal O_X)_y$ and $M=(R^0f_*\mathcal O_X)_y$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk], with direct image and cohomology [pqf-def-cohomology]. For $n\ge0$ put $X_n=\operatorname{Spec}(A/\mathfrak m^{n+1})\times_Y X$, with projection $i_n$, and let $C_n=H^0(X_n,i_n^*\mathcal O_X)$ and $S_n=\Gamma(X_n,\mathcal O_{X_n})$ with their $\widehat A$-actions and transition maps [def-weil-pbc-formal-fibre-cohomology]; pullback is [def-pc-module-pullback] and cohomology h-maps are [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap]. There exist an $A$-linear equivalence $a:M_0\to M$ and an isomorphism of inverse systems $b:C\to S$ over $\widehat A$ such that, for each $n$, every $A$-linear canonical stalk map $\theta_n:M\to C_n$ satisfying IsFormalFunctionsTheta [def-weil-pbc-formal-fibre-cohomology], every open $V\ni y$ whose inverse image under $f i_n$ contains all of $X_n$, and every $t\in\Gamma(f^{-1}V,\mathcal O_X)$, one has $b_n(\theta_n(a([t]_V)))=i_n^*(t)$. No properness, Noetherian or completion-comparison assertion is assumed or concluded.
